 Order

This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 304/2019 under Sections 498A/406/506/34 IPC,
registered at Police Station Badarpur, as also the proceedings emanating from the said FIR.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that both the parties have come to an amicable settlement at Delhi Mediation Centre, Saket Courts and in terms of the Settlement,
petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 have obtained divorce by mutual consent on 20.03.2024.
He further submits that in terms of Settlement, petitioner No. 1 was to pay a sum of Rs. 7,50,000/- to respondent No. 2.

He has already paid Rs. 5,00,000/- to respondent No. 2 and balance Rs.
2,50,000/- is paid today.
3. Upon being asked, respondent no.2 expressed her ignorance of the decree of divorce granted by family court.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/08/2025 at 22:42:38 terms of settlement.
4. Secretary Delhi High Court Legal Services Authority ["DHCLSA"] is therefore directed to provide an advocate at State expense to respondent No. 2, to assist her in the present petition.
